| [QUESTION-292](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-292.md) | What evidence would show that a maintaining link, and not a regime's content, keeps a disorder in place: does the efficacy of a treatment that targets the link count, or only change in the link that is specific and comes before the outcome? | The evidential part of [QUESTION-045](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-045.md), split off by the status review of 2026-10-27 under [ADR-049](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-049.md), because [THEORY-053](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-053.md) (Active) settles it. | [QUESTION-297](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-297.md) | When the effects of trauma reach descendants who did not live through it, by which route do they travel: germline epigenetics, the womb, parenting, or a group's narrative and identity; and on the identity route, does an ancestor's injury become part of the descendant's self? | The owner's question of 2026-10-29, beside the legacy line: the past acting on later generations, where legacy is the living acting for them.
